request.style: anime game trailer music, dramatic build-up from tense ticking piano and pulsing synth intro into explosive J-pop rock with bright 8-bit chiptune lead, driving electric guitars, punchy drums, orchestral hits, heroic determined climax, E minor, 150 BPM

music.post: instrumental 模式仍唱了歌（scripts/pv/music_probe.py：whisper-small 在 demucs 人声声部里识别出成句的日语/英语歌词）。用 scripts/pv/strip_vocals.py 去掉人声声部（drums+bass+other），复检人声声部 −72 dB、识别结果为乱码；再 ffmpeg libvorbis -q:a 6 编码。
music.choice: 候选 1 的结构最贴合 PV：41~62 秒安静、58.8~60.4 秒换气、63.0 秒爆发、83.2 秒起断奏段、103 秒再推起。librosa 估计 95.7 BPM（拍长约 0.627 秒）。未经人耳试听。
